$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the summary declares schema_version 0.2.0 and carries no waivers
block, which is what a 0.2.x file looks like. readSummary refuses anything outside 0.3.x, because a
different version is a changed contract and scoring it would report a contract migration as a
quality regression. This case pins that refusal as an environment-parser failure with nothing
scored. The matrix beside it is seeded-correct-run's and is never
read, because runCase stops at the summary.
derivation: readSummary takes the first two dotted parts of schema_version, 0.2, and compares them with the 0.3
this harness scores. They differ, so it returns not ok with failureClass environment-parser, the class
runCase reports for an artifact it cannot read. Nothing is scored and no signature exists for this
case, so it takes no part in checkTraceSignatures.
